contractEnforcements.serviceScope: renderer/js/r3-0e-followup-timeline.js exports createFollowUpTimelineService({timelineStore, followUpLinkStore}) → service object + verifyAuthoritativeFollowUpLink + verifyAuthoritativeTimelineProjection. Service methods: createFollowUpLink / getFollowUpLink / listFollowUpLinksForParent / appendTimelineEvent / projectTimeline. NO mutation API: timeline events are append-only; corrections are NEW events with params.correction_of=<priorEventId>. NO WeakSet, register, secret, or signing primitive exported.
contractEnforcements.inputAuthority: All input wrappers have CLOSED key sets ({parentCaseId, followUpCaseId, experimentId, parentStatus} for links; {caseId, kind, i18nKey, params, correctionOf} for events; {clock, referenceNowMs} for opts). Symbol / accessor / non-enumerable / Proxy / unknown own key → BLOCK with UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY before any [[Get]].
contractEnforcements.deterministicIds: linkId = 'link_' + FNV-1a(parentCaseId, followUpCaseId, experimentId); eventId = 'event_' + FNV-1a(caseId, sequence, kind, i18nKey); projectionId = 'projection_' + FNV-1a(caseId, eventCount, lastEventId). NO clock leak in any id.
contractEnforcements.appendOnly: Timeline events are append-only at BOTH layers — the service computes sequence from existing events length; the E2 store also rejects duplicate eventId + out-of-order createdAt. A clock rollback (refMs < prev event ms) is caught at the service layer with TIMELINE_ORDERING_INVALID before reaching the store.
contractEnforcements.i18nGrammar: Event i18nKey passes the strict grammar (dotted lower_snake_case, 2..6 segments, ≤128 chars). Event params is null OR a plain object whose keys are sober identifiers and whose values are: finite number / boolean / null / strict i18n key / strict id string. Free-text / blame / causation / path / raw-telemetry-array smuggling is blocked.
contractEnforcements.correctionEvents: A correction event is a new event whose params.correction_of references the prior event id. The original is NEVER overwritten — the projection includes BOTH events in chronological order.
contractEnforcements.clockOrdering: Clock invoked AT MOST ONCE per call, AFTER all authority + structural gates. Forged input → ZERO clock invocations.
contractEnforcements.producerAttestation: Every successfully-created follow-up link record AND every projected timeline is deep-frozen and registered in a closure-private WeakSet. Verifiers check identity + structural witnesses. Clones / JSON round-trips / structuredClone / Proxy lookalikes do NOT pass. WeakSet ops + Array.prototype ops dispatched via captured intrinsics + captured Reflect.apply.
contractEnforcements.rehydrationAuthority: Reload across service instances (same backend, fresh service factory) produces a deterministic projection with identical projectionId. Each rehydrated event is re-validated via E1 contract and rebuilt into a service-owned frozen copy before being included in the projection.
contractEnforcements.crossCaseScopePolicy: The follow-up link service PERMITS cross-case linkage (it records the relationship). The comparison-validity gate that requires same-case / same-session / explicit-reference / comparabilityScore lives in E3 outcome classifier — link existence does NOT imply comparison validity.
